target: rule:canonical/rules/always/explain.md (documents, reports and reviews follow the user's language) with the matching skills and agents
notes: PRD 2026-11-06, success signals G1 to G5. Baseline: the v0.8.0 render. Candidate: this change. Both arms run Claude Code in throwaway config directories. After each document case, run `buracle plan validate <file> --strict` from the candidate checkout on the PRD or plan the run wrote (its work folder) and expect exit 0. The memory case needs a throwaway CortexDB (BURACLE_CORTEXDB_BIN and a sandboxed BURACLE_HOME), as the ab-test skill describes. The stop case asks the agent to register the plan first, because a one-shot run starts with no bound plan. Workflow cases start with the slash command, as a user types it: the workflow skills are user-invoked only (disable-model-invocation), so a plain request cannot start them, and a slash command is no Skill tool call, so those cases probe the buracle commands instead.
